The three momenta have positive energies, zero CM spatial total and noncollinear directions; collinear boundaries are excluded.
The common helicity is fixed to either +1 or -1. The source does not select their relative amplitude.
The oriented plane normal follows the ordered first two momenta; odd permutations change the full polarization product by a sign.
The source pair is the encoded four-dimensional carrier from the prior audit, not an independently identified physical electron/positron preparation or the full raw 64-dimensional space.
General normalization and rotation intertwining use analytic simplex/Haar inputs and are not machine-formalized.
